expected: Provider credential findings should survive the configured secrets-scanner threshold.
defect: SecretsScanner maps recognized Stripe and GitHub credentials below its HIGH threshold and drops them.

fault location.explanation: Description-based severity mapping puts certain provider credentials below the default threshold.

Root cause: Source confirmed: severity is inferred from description substrings; token/secret fall through to MEDIUM unless a higher-priority substring matches. The scanner default threshold is HIGH, and archived evidence records raw_findings=1 but filtered_findings=0. Runs where gitleaks raw_findings=0 do not demonstrate this filtering defect. Failure precedes LLM triage; no model attribution is needed. No fresh runtime reproduction was performed during this organization. Exact first fixing commit has not been established.
